claims.text: Many reviewers praise the butter as high quality, pure, and effective, especially for moisturizing skin and hair.
Several reviewers note the butter arrives as a hard, solid brick that requires melting, whipping, or processing before use, which some found unexpected or inconvenient.
Some reviewers mention a natural, earthy, smoky/nutty scent rather than a commercial shea fragrance, which most describe as light or pleasant.
A few reviewers report hard gritty particles or rock-like chunks hidden in the butter that can scratch skin.
Reviewers note the butter may arrive melted in hot weather but generally arrives on time and packaged with care.
